definition: to talk about something and examine it
description: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.
transcript: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?
